# opnsense_interfaces_vxlan (Resource)

VXLAN interfaces (Interfaces > Devices > VXLAN). Set either `remote_address` (unicast) or `group` (multicast).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_interfaces_vxlan" "dc" {
  vni            = "100"
  local_address  = "198.51.100.10"
  remote_address = "198.51.100.20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_address` (String) Source address for the tunnel.
- `vni` (String) VXLAN network identifier (1-16777215).

### Optional

- `group` (String) Multicast group address. Defaults to `""`.
- `interface` (String) Interface for multicast traffic, e.g. `wan`. Defaults to `""`.
- `local_port` (String) Local UDP port; empty uses 4789. Defaults to `""`.
- `remote_address` (String) Unicast remote address. Defaults to `""`.
- `remote_port` (String) Remote UDP port; empty uses 4789. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Device name assigned by OPNsense, e.g. `vxlan1`.
- `id` (String) UUID of the VXLAN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_interfaces_vxlan.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
